name: x2611_11972_eq2_9
original:
For $|z|<1$ , we define the following generating function

 $\displaystyle S(z)$ 
 $\displaystyle=\displaystyle\sum_{1\leq k<\ell}\displaystyle\frac{k}{(k^{2}-z^{2})(\ell^{2}-z^{2})}.$ 

Let $\ell=k+r$ . Then we have

 $\displaystyle S(z)$ 
 $\displaystyle=\displaystyle\sum_{k,r\geq 1}\displaystyle\frac{k}{(k^{2}-z^{2})((k+r)^{2}-z^{2})}$ 

 $\displaystyle=\displaystyle\sum_{k,r\geq 1}\displaystyle\frac{k}{r(2k+r)}\left(\displaystyle\frac{1}{k^{2}-z^{2}}-\displaystyle\frac{1}{(k+r)^{2}-z^{2}}\right).$ 

Since

 $\displaystyle\displaystyle\sum_{r=1}^{\infty}\displaystyle\frac{k}{r(2k+r)}=\displaystyle\frac{1}{2}\displaystyle\sum_{r=1}^{\infty}\left(\displaystyle\frac{1}{r}-\displaystyle\frac{1}{r+2k}\right)=\displaystyle\frac{1}{2}H_{2k},$ 

and

 $\displaystyle\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{n-1}\displaystyle\frac{k}{(n-k)(n+k)}$ 
 $\displaystyle=\displaystyle\frac{1}{2}\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{n-1}\left(\displaystyle\frac{1}{n-k}-\displaystyle\frac{1}{n+k}\right)=H_{n}-\displaystyle\frac{1}{2}H_{2n}-\displaystyle\frac{1}{4n},$ 

we obtain

 $\displaystyle S(z)=C(z)-A(z)+\displaystyle\frac{1}{4}Z(z),$ 

(2.9)

where

 $\displaystyle A(z)=\displaystyle\sum_{n\geq 1}\displaystyle\frac{H_{n}}{n^{2}-z^{2}},\quad C(z)=\displaystyle\sum_{n\geq 1}\displaystyle\frac{H_{2n}}{n^{2}-z^{2}},\quad Z(z)=\displaystyle\sum_{n\geq 1}\displaystyle\frac{1}{n(n^{2}-z^{2})}.$
